name: tanksandtemples
description: Tanks and Temples is a standard benchmark for multi‑view stereo and 3D reconstruction that evaluates how well algorithms recover detailed scene geometry from calibrated image sets. It provides multiple real-world scenes with held‑out ground truth geometry and standardized evaluation protocols to compare mesh/pointcloud reconstruction quality. Widely used for evaluating multi‑view stereo, photogrammetry and surface reconstruction methods.
evaluation_method: F-score / precision-recall based reconstruction metrics (and related completeness/accuracy thresholds)
typical_sota_score: varies by scene; roughly 40–90% F‑score depending on scene difficulty and method
reputation: A long‑standing, widely used benchmark in the multi‑view stereo and 3D reconstruction community for real‑world scene evaluation.
